panels.description: Alex stands before a bookcase with one narrow gap behind technical manuals. Keep the upper shelves clear.
Alex turns Adrian's watch over to reveal the looping equation engraved on the caseback. Keep the upper frame clear.
Alex places the notebook in the gap; the shelf shifts inward. Keep the upper shelf clear.
The bookcase swings open to a dark hidden workshop as Ada stands beside Alex. Keep the upper doorway clear.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: That’s one way to hide a room.
